title: Combined Lower Subordinate Services (Intermediate Level) Main Exam 2025
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC)
salary_range: Pay Matrix Level-2 to Level-3 (Rs. 5200-20200, GP Rs. 1900 / Rs. 2000 or Rs. 19900 - 63200)
application_fee: Rs. 25 (Online Processing Fee for all categories; Examination fee to be paid separately by shortlisted candidates)
age_limit: 18 to 40 years as of 1st July of the recruitment year (relaxations as per rules)
summary: The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has invited online applications for the Combined Lower Subordinate Services (Intermediate Level) Main Examination 2025 to fill 1784 vacancies across various departments. Candidates must have appeared in the UPSSSC PET-2025 to be eligible for shortlisting. Applications can be submitted online via the official website upsssc.gov.in.
eligibility_bullets: Must have valid score from UPSSSC Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) - 2025.

Minimum educational qualification: Intermediate (12th Pass) or equivalent from a recognized board, along with specific requirements (such as computer certificates, typing knowledge, or experience) depending on the post.
Age limit between 18 to 40 years as of July 1st of the recruitment year, with applicable relaxations for reserved categories.

how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official website upsssc.gov.in and navigate to the Live Advertisement section.
Login using your UPSSSC PET-2025 registration number and OTP sent to your registered mobile/email.
Select the desired post(s), verify your personal details, educational qualifications, and other information.
Pay the mandatory online processing fee of Rs. 25 using Credit/Debit Card, Net Banking, UPI, or SBI e-Chalan.
Submit the final application form and take a printout for future reference and document verification.
pay_level: Pay Matrix Level-2 To Level-3 (7th CPC)
